property_summary: Calling transfer with a non-empty recipient list and valid from/caddress succeeds in both but returns true in reference and false in the bug.
Calling transfer with a single recipient and valid parameters succeeds in both versions but returns true in reference and false in the bug.

When calling transfer with _tos = [address(0x1), address(0x2)] and v = 0, the reference contract iterates exactly twice (i=0 and i=1) and succeeds, while the buggy contract iterates a third time (i=2) and reverts due to out-of-bounds access on _tos[2].
Calling transfer with an empty _tos array reverts in the reference but succeeds in the mutant, observable by whether the call reverts.
Calling transfer with empty _tos array reverts in the reference but succeeds in the mutant, observable by try/catch on the call.
